title: Price by reference to a price list

list_role.doc: Role that attests the reference price list.

factor.doc: Multiplier applied to the reference price.

render: The price of each Item in scope is its price in the most recent reference price list attested by {{list_role|role}} that is effective at the time of purchase, multiplied by {{factor}} and rounded {{rounding|rounding}}.
